sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL whimsical game controller literally carved from a thick irregular slab of golden Swiss cheese, NOT a cheese skin on a recognizable commercial controller. Distinct wide rounded trapezoid silhouette like a rustic cheese cutting slab with a gently scalloped rind, uneven corners and a tiny bite missing from the upper left. No familiar long gamepad handles, no console manufacturer's casing or silhouette. Top-down orthographic front, landscape 3:2 image, entire device visible with generous transparent margin. Deep cheese holes, porous waxy buttery texture, rich orange rind, a few cheese crumbs adhered to edges. Polished tactile illustrated realism with soft lighting matching a plumbing comedy game's UI. Actual functional controls remain clear dark charcoal hardware inset into cheese: upper-left analog stick, lower-left cross D-pad, lower-middle/right analog stick, four black circular buttons in a diamond on right with LARGE legible colored letters Y yellow at top, B red at right, A green at bottom, X blue at left. Two small centrally placed black buttons with clear white generic overlapping-rectangles View symbol and three-horizontal-lines Menu symbol. Two small dark shoulder triggers projecting from top edge. No logos, no branding, no power emblem, no extra letters, no hands, no plate, no background. Genuine transparent alpha. Cheese holes must not obscure any controls. This is a new fictional cheese device rather than a replica of any real model.

Use case: product-mockup. Game UI illustration asset: a single compact tenkeyless ANSI US QWERTY keyboard, straight top-down orthographic view, wide landscape 3:1 composition with entire keyboard visible and 5% transparent margin. Smooth richly painted realistic game illustration matching a gross plumbing action-comedy, premium soft studio shading and rounded beveled keycaps. A worn cream/off-white keyboard with charcoal dark keycaps, subtle teal accent keycaps on A, D, W, spacebar and warm brass accent on Enter. Correct conventional keyboard rows and readable standard legends, including ESC, Tab, QWERTY, ASDF, ZXCV, long Spacebar, Enter, separate inverted-T arrows on right, no numpad. Authentic restrained plumbing grime: greasy fingerprints, dried rusty water rings on casing, scuffed corners, a little olive sludge caught in crevices, tiny piece of white plumber's tape on outer casing only. Dirt stays off key legends. Mature tactile polished art, not pixel art, not cartoon polygon shapes. No extra props, no hands, no text outside normal key legends, no annotations, no game instructions, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark. Genuine transparent background, no backdrop or cast rectangular shadow.

Use case: product-mockup. Single generic unbranded modern console gamepad game-UI asset, top-down front view, entire silhouette visible with clear 8% transparent margin, landscape 3:2 canvas. Familiar Xbox-compatible layout but original housing and NO Xbox emblem or any branding. Soft smoothly sculpted rounded ergonomic grips, warm ivory worn shell, dark charcoal rubberized grips, recessed offset analog sticks (left upper, right lower), cross D-pad lower-left, four glossy round face buttons upper-right in correct diamond: Y yellow top, B red right, A green bottom, X blue left. Two small center buttons with generic overlapping-rectangles View symbol and three horizontal Menu lines. Blank center where logo would be. Shoulder bumpers and triggers visible at top, correct RT on right. Premium smooth painted realistic game illustration, beveled controls, soft occlusion, coherent highlights, real depth, polished tactile rendering rather than crude shapes. Subtle plumbing theme: oily fingerprints, rust specks at screw holes, faint olive grime at seams, small strip white plumber's tape on outer grip, never obscure buttons or letters. No wires, hands, props, callout lines, instructions, extra text, logos, watermark. Genuine transparent background.
